I can't answer that from this evidence. The analyst asked about the two weeks *before* 2026-10-04, but the evidence unit covers 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03, which is the period *after* that date. It says nothing about the earlier window.

For the period it does cover (4 October to 3 November 2026), NASA FIRMS recorded no thermal detections intersecting the property. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of that period.

Even for that later period, "no detection" doesn't prove there was no fire. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can be missed. The evidence also says nothing about burned area or the cause of any change on the land.

To answer the original question, you'd need a FIRMS check for roughly 20 September to 3 October 2026.
